transcript.content: Hello, welcome. What brings you in to see me today?

Hi, doctor. Well, I'm here because lately I just keep forgetting little things that I normally handle without an issue. Like, I'll forget to return a phone call, or I'll forget to turn in a registration form. Or I'll completely forget to stop and run an errand on my way home from work. It's just getting frustrating, and that's what finally made me ask for some help.
Aside from feeling frustrated, how has your mood been lately?

Um, my mood has been fine, honestly. I don't feel down or sad or anything like that. It really is just... well, just being annoyed with myself for dropping the ball on things at work and at home. But other than that, I feel pretty normal.
Did you ever have trouble with attention, focus, or organization while growing up, such as during your school years?

Yeah, I did, actually. Um... even back in elementary school, I was always the kid who forgot permission slips. I would do my homework and then just lose it somewhere in the bottom of my backpack. And when it came to bigger projects, my mom or my teachers always had to remind me, like, step by step, just to make sure I actually finished them. So, yeah, it's been an issue for a while.
Do you often feel restless or have a hard time sitting still for long periods?

Not exactly restless like I need to get up and walk around, but... well, during longer classes or meetings at work, I do notice myself clicking my pen a lot. Or I'll be bouncing my foot, or just shifting around in my chair. Even when I’m really trying to sit still and pay attention to what's going on, I just end up doing those little things.
